translation: The original text of the 《Bencao Jing》: 射干 (yègān), flavor bitter, neutral. It governs cough and retching with upward counterflow (咳逆上氣), throat-bi and throat pain (喉痹咽痛), inability to rest (不得消息), disperses bound qi (散結氣), evil counterflow in the abdomen (腹中邪逆), and great heat from food and drink (食飲大熱).
